architecture: llama2.c Transformer (Llama-2-style decoder: RMSNorm, RoPE, grouped-query attention, SwiGLU feed-forward, tied input/output embedding)
tokenizer: tok4096: our 4,096-token SentencePiece BPE (tok4096.model; tok4096.bin in llama2.c format)
weights: model.safetensors holds the float32 weights. output.weight is not stored: it is tok_embeddings.weight (load with strict=False). The print job runs an int8 copy, one scale per row, written by export.py.
